\sin 610^\circ=\sin 250^\circ=-\sin 70^\circ,\quad \cos 430^\circ=\cos 70^\circ
\]

Numerator:
\[
\sqrt{1+2\sin 250^\circ\cos 70^\circ}
=\sqrt{1-2\sin 70^\circ\cos 70^\circ}
=\sqrt{1-\sin 40^\circ}
\]
Since
\[
1-\sin 40^\circ=(\cos 20^\circ-\sin 20^\circ)^2,
\]
and \(\cos 20^\circ>\sin 20^\circ\), the numerator is
\[
\cos 20^\circ-\sin 20^\circ.
\]

Denominator:
\[
\sin 250^\circ+\cos 790^\circ
=\sin 250^\circ+\cos 70^\circ
=-\sin 70^\circ+\cos 70^\circ
=\sin 20^\circ-\cos 20^\circ.
\]

Thus:
\[
\frac{\cos 20^\circ-\sin 20^\circ}{\sin 20^\circ-\cos 20^\circ}=-1.
\]
